description: List the health-data network participants (organizations Particle can query). Optionally filter by state or zipcode, and page with continuation_token. Endpoint: GET /api/v1/networkparticipants (with /state/{state} and /zipcode/{zip} variants).

continuation_token.description: Token from a previous response to fetch the next page.

state.description: Two-letter US state code to filter participants, e.g. NY.

zipcode.description: 5-digit ZIP code to filter participants (ignored if `state` is set).

name: particle_search_network_participants
title: Search network participants
